The interrupted Google import finished. Every planned request succeeded (18 of 18), so the outage didn't leave any gaps in this job.

**Job:** `job_2a4a7deb6cb9`, activity category only, for Oct 1–3, 2026 (the window the job was set up with).

**Imported activity coverage:**
- **Steps:** 3 daily records, one for each day from Oct 1 to Oct 3. Nothing was updated or left unchanged, and nothing was marked deleted.
- **Everything else in activity came back empty:** active energy burned, active minutes, active zone minutes, activity level, altitude, basal energy burned, calories in heart rate zone, distance, floors, sedentary period, swim lengths, time in heart rate zone, and total calories. Each request succeeded but returned no records.

**Caveats:**
- "Empty" means Google returned no data for those types in this window. It could mean there was no activity to record, or that the permission for those types wasn't granted. I can't tell which from here.
- The import only covered three days, so this is not a full history. Other categories (sleep, heart, body, and so on) have no local records yet.
- Sync state for Google now shows data synced through Oct 3.

If you want, I can start a broader activity import for a longer date range.
